name: Stage 1 — Establish the Company’s Position
description: Functional executives: consult the colleague named in your question. CEO: ask each executive, “What is your recommendation, and why is your question important for the company to resolve?” You have no separate comprehension submission.
stage_manipulation: Distributed executive evidence; decisions require consultation across functions.
context_brief_template: Functional executives: consult the colleague named in your question. CEO: ask each executive, “What is your recommendation, and why is your question important for the company to resolve?” You have no separate comprehension submission. Coach the decision process only. Do not supply or infer private figures, another executive's answers, or the preferred ranking. Ask the participant to obtain missing evidence from the responsible executive through team chat.

tasks.name: Chief Financial Officer (CFO) · Establish the company's position
tasks.hitl_prompt: PLACEHOLDER — write a question this executive can only answer by combining one fact from the COO's private briefing and one from the CTO's. Consult the COO and the CTO before answering.
